messages:
maria: Hey team — opened a small PR to remove an obsolete team alias from CODEOWNERS. It touches /runtime/* and /infra/deploy. GitHub is blocking merge with 'no required approvers found'. Who can actually approve this? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412

raj: Quick context — we replaced a few old aliases last quarter. CODEOWNERS should reference the new org team slugs (e.g., @redwood/runtime). If the old alias is gone, GH might not know who the approvers are. But if both runtime and infra are listed, one of those teams should be able to approve.

sam: pinging @runtime-team and @infra here. If this is purely housekeeping (alias -> new team slug) I'm fine with it once CI is green. Any behavioral risk?

maria: No behavioral changes — just swapping the alias. I also saw CI fail on a linter complaining about trailing whitespace in CODEOWNERS, that's why it's blocked.

raj: Can you paste the relevant snippet so we can eyeball it?

maria: ```
# before
/runtime/* @old-runtime
/infra/deploy/* @infra-team

# after
/runtime/* @runtime
/infra/deploy/* @infra-team
```

sam: Looks straightforward. If infra path remains, infra approval can merge too. @jen from infra — are you able to approve?

jen: I'm here. I don't object. CI issue sounds like a lint nit. If maria squashes the trailing whitespace and re-pushes I can approve and merge. Are there any other touched files?

maria: Only CODEOWNERS. Fixing whitespace now.

ci-bot: build #412 failed — CODEOWNERS lint error: trailing-space on line 3

maria: Fixed and pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412/commits/7a9f2c9 — removed trailing space.

sam: Thanks. One thing to watch: GitHub sometimes shows 'no required approvers' if the team slug doesn't exactly match org/team. If it's still blocked after CI, double-check the team slug in the org settings (no leading @ in CODEOWNERS entry, but GitHub UI shows @).

raj: Also remember repo settings has 'require-codeowner-approval' enabled — so an explicit team/individual listed must match an existing codeowner. If you removed the alias but forgot to add the new slug, GH will treat it as unknown.

maria: CI passed. The PR now shows pending review from @infra-team but it's mergeable if infra approves. I'm not in either team so can't merge myself.

jen: I approved and merged it. :shipit:  (merged in 7a9f2c9)

maria: Thanks everyone! That unblocked a couple small follow-ups. :tada:
